scenes.label: AGENT PERFORMANCE, EXPLAINED
scenes.caption: Profile your agent. Find repeated work. Verify the effect of a change.

scenes.label: 01 / START LOCALLY
scenes.caption: From a source checkout, run the quickstart. No model API key is needed.

scenes.label: 02 / RECORD YOUR RUN
scenes.caption: Wrap your functions, retain the output you want to evaluate, and export a trace.

scenes.label: 03 / INSPECT THE EVIDENCE
scenes.caption: This offline fixture has three serial lookups. Check independence and shared-state safety before parallelizing.

scenes.label: 04 / COMPARE THE CHANGE
scenes.caption: Record a candidate, then replay both traces with quality checks. These timings are synthetic demonstration data.

scenes.label: 05 / CHECK MORE THAN ONE RUN
scenes.caption: Repeat across tasks and seeds. Keep the failures: one candidate here fails quality, despite running faster.

scenes.label: 06 / SHARE THE EVIDENCE
scenes.caption: Save the intervention and study results. Export one HTML file for an offline review.

scenes.label: TRY AGENTLOOP
scenes.caption: Start with the example, then bring your own agent and task-specific quality checks.
